# ui::testing::TestAutomationEvents

Header: `winui/testing/TestAutomationEvents.hpp`.

Derives from `ui::AutomationEvents`.

[AutomationEvents](../tree/automation-events.md) test double: keeps a line of text for every event a window reports, the way a screen reader would hear about it. Structure changes go to [`structure`](#structure) instead, as they come with many changes and say little on their own.

Install it with seams(window).set_automation_events(); the window then reports to it after each layout. Set [`listening_now`](#listening_now) to false to act as if no screen reader is listening, and the window reports nothing.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::testing::TestAutomationEvents events;
ui::testing::seams(window).set_automation_events(&events);
ui::testing::seams(window).handle_key({ui::Key::Tab, ui::KeyAction::Down});
REQUIRE(events.log == std::vector<std::string>{"focus Button \"Save\""});
```

## listening_now

```cpp
bool listening_now = true
```

Whether the window should report; true by default.

## log

```cpp
std::vector<std::string> log
```

One line per event: `focus <role> "<name>"`, or `<property> "<name>": <before> -> <after>`.

## focused

```cpp
std::vector<Element*> focused
```

The node of each focus event, in order.

## structure

```cpp
std::vector<Element*> structure
```

The node of each structure change, in order.

## listening

```cpp
bool listening() const override
```

Whether a client is listening; while false the window skips the checks.

## focus_changed

```cpp

```

`node` took keyboard focus as automation sees it.

```cpp

```

`property` of `node`, the node with automation focus, went from `before` to `after`.

```cpp
void menu_opened(Element& menu) override
```

A menu (a node with AutomationRole::Menu) opened.

```cpp
void menu_closed(Element& menu) override
```
